clips.title: The story
paras: Along the Merchant Coast, Mahren Skyseer calls you to a hunt in the Great Sea. You are to slay Isha Awak, the Deep Doom, and bring back its heart for a rite of spirit and respect.

South of Ratchet, Isha Awak prowls beneath the waves. Known as the Deep Doom, this immense sea creature commands the coastal waters with great strength. Human forces camped along the shore fear those waters after losing many scouts and soldiers to the predator's hunger.

Mahren Skyseer reveres the leviathan, unlike the humans who fear it. To the tauren mystic, Isha Awak is no curse or mere pest, but a worthy foe whose might tests a hunter's resolve. Slaying the beast is an act of spiritual communion. Its heart holds the beast's essence, and claiming it lets the hunter carry that untamed spirit forward.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters. Great is his strength, and solemn his pride. The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.
But I do not fear him. I am grateful he is here. He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.
If you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.
His spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You now are one with Isha Awak, friend. His spirit is with you. He lurks in your eyes...
Eyes that, one day, will learn to see.
